prompt:
Create ONE original production character turnaround sheet for a tactical dark-fantasy RPG. Three equal orthographic full-body views side by side: FRONT at x=1/6 of canvas, strict RIGHT PROFILE facing left at x=1/2, BACK at x=5/6. Same identity, costume, anatomy, scale and neutral standing A-pose in all views; feet on a single shared baseline, head tops aligned. Arms relaxed 20 degrees away from sides, hands closed but empty, legs shoulder width. No weapons, no shields, no scenery, no cast shadows, no perspective, no platform, no text, no labels. Plain uniform light warm gray background. Fill about 85% of canvas height, generous separate margins between views. Adult realistic heroic anatomy 7 heads tall, natural small eyes, detailed human facial structure, physically constructed clothing with meaningful seams, tension folds, hard armor planes and thin turned edges. Art direction: accomplished hand-painted diffuse game character, painted warm edge highlights, cool designed shadow shapes, broad brush-painted color planes, selectively crisp contours, convincing steel/leather/wool distinctions. Not clay, not toy, not smooth plastic, not chibi, not cartoon round sausage hair or inflated fabric. This is ORIGINAL DESIGN REFERENCE ART, not a photographed miniature. Wide landscape sheet.
DESIGN: A seasoned 45-year-old mercenary, lean broad-shouldered, close-cropped swept ash-brown hair and short natural stubble beard, weathered face. Long midnight-blue quilted gambeson, closely fitted dark russet leather brigandine with small irregular rivet rows (no exposed chocolate-bar tiles), one understated dark-steel shoulder guard, woven muted blue wool half-cloak gathered on his left shoulder and falling to mid calf at back, leather belt with buckle and two useful pouches, dark trousers and well-fitted leather riding boots with straps. Restrained navy, warm brown, bone linen and gray steel. Clear elegant silhouette and anatomical wrists/ankles.
purpose: original multi-view design reference; not an actual model render
